name: hud_line_clip_clip_endpoint_to_y
description: HudLineClip::ClipEndpointToY moves one segment endpoint to a requested Y and linearly interpolates its X coordinate.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation at 0x4bdb30 have no warnings or tags and compute endpoint->x += (other->x - endpoint->x) * ((clipY - endpoint->y) / (other->y - endpoint->y)), then set endpoint->y to clipY.
The native line-clip smoke clips an endpoint from (0,0) toward (10,20) at Y=10 and verifies the resulting (5,10).
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4bdb30 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
